# Shunya

> Shunya (shunya.so) is an Indian CA (Chartered Accountant) services platform for company registration and compliance. CA-assisted, online, end to end: Private Limited / LLP / OPC registration, GST registration and returns, ITR and tax audit, Form 15CA/15CB (now Form 145/146) for foreign remittances, lower TDS certificates for NRIs, FSSAI, GST LUT and refunds, Startup India, and company closure. Each service has a plain-language guide cluster written for Indian founders and businesses; figures and rules are stated as of the "Last updated" date on each page.

## Core Services

- [Company Registration](https://shunya.so/company-registration): Register a Private Limited Company, LLP or OPC in India online — end-to-end CA-assisted process.
- [GST Registration](https://shunya.so/gst-registration): Get GST registered online with a CA — GSTIN delivered in 5–7 working days, ₹1,499 one-time.
- [GST Return Filing](https://shunya.so/gst-return-filing): Monthly GST return filing (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9) by a CA, filed before every due date, ₹799/month.
- [Form 15CA/15CB (now Form 145/146) Filing](https://shunya.so/15ca-15cb): Form 15CA and 15CB — renamed Form 145 and Form 146 from 1 April 2026 — filed by a CA for foreign remittance payments, no office visit required.
- [Lower TDS Certificate for NRIs](https://shunya.so/lower-tds-certificate-nri): Lower or Nil TDS Certificate — Form 13, now renamed Form 128 — for NRI property sales, rent or interest income. Capital gains computed and filed by a CA, from ₹4,999.
- [FSSAI Registration & License](https://shunya.so/fssai-registration): FSSAI Basic Registration, State License or Central License filed on FoSCoS, with the 2026 turnover limits and perpetual validity built in. From ₹1,499.
- [GST LUT Filing](https://shunya.so/gst-lut): GST Letter of Undertaking (Form RFD-11) so you can export without paying IGST upfront. CA-assisted, ARN same day. From ₹499.
- [Company Closure](https://shunya.so/company-closure): Close a private limited company, LLP or OPC in India with an MCA-registered CA. Pick your entity type; strike-off filing and ROC follow-up handled online. From ₹5,999.
- [Private Limited Company Closure](https://shunya.so/company-closure-private-limited): Close a private limited company via Form STK-2 strike-off under Section 248(2) of the Companies Act. Typical total ₹7,999 – ₹15,999 depending on the case; exact quote before you pay.
- [LLP Closure](https://shunya.so/company-closure-llp): Close an LLP via Form 24 strike-off under Rule 37 of the LLP Rules 2009. Typical total ₹5,999 – ₹11,999 depending on the case; exact quote before you pay.
- [OPC Closure](https://shunya.so/company-closure-opc): Close a One Person Company via Form STK-2 strike-off, with a single-signatory resolution, bond and affidavit. Typical total ₹7,999 – ₹12,999 depending on the case; exact quote before you pay.
- [ITR Filing](https://shunya.so/itr-filing): File your Income Tax Return online with a qualified CA before the 31 July 2026 deadline. Salaried, capital gains, freelancer income. From ₹999.
- [Tax Audit (Section 44AB)](https://shunya.so/tax-audit-44ab): Tax audit under Section 44AB filed by a Chartered Accountant — Form 3CA/3CB and 3CD, UDIN-tagged, before the 30 September 2026 deadline. From ₹4,999. F&O traders, professionals, businesses.
- [GST Refund Filing](https://shunya.so/gst-refund-filing): File your GST refund claim online with a qualified CA — export, inverted duty, excess balance refunds. RFD-01 preparation, filing & follow-up till credited.
- [GSTR-9 & GSTR-9C Annual Return Filing](https://shunya.so/gstr-9-gstr-9c-filing): File GSTR-9 annual return and GSTR-9C reconciliation online with a qualified CA. Books-to-return reconciliation, ITC review. From ₹1,999.
- [Startup India (DPIIT) Registration](https://shunya.so/startup-india): DPIIT recognition under the Startup India scheme.
- [Free Business, Tax & Loan Calculators](https://shunya.so/tools): About 50 free calculators — GST, TDS, advance tax, EMI, SIP/SWP, CAGR, business setup cost and more.
- [Free Consultation](https://shunya.so/consultation): Book a call with a CA to discuss your compliance needs.
- [How It Works](https://shunya.so/how-it-works): Step-by-step walkthrough of the Shunya process.
